name: @dsh-toolset/escalation-hint
description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）escalation-hint 插件：沙箱拒绝但宿主没给升级提示时，经 tools/post-execute 追加一条重试指引（只提示、不拦截）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-escalation-hint && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-escalation-hint && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-escalation-hint node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-escalation-hint tmp/cov-escalation-hint/report.json
